Resolves #19235

Row 162 of `.neo-ai-data/concepts/edges.jsonl` now points `dream-pipeline` at `file:src/evolution/RemDigestion.mjs`, the Brain file that replaced the deleted `ai/daemons/orchestrator/services/DreamService.mjs`. This was the one stale file reference left in the 182-edge ontology once `neomjs/neo-agent-brain#526` resolves references in `neo-agent-brain`, then in `neo.mjs`.

Evidence: L2 (the JSONL parses, 182 rows; the package-contents contract passes) → L2 required. Residual: none.

Micro-review eligible: data — one JSONL row, no code.

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | The diff is one row, 162, and `edges.jsonl` still parses as 182 rows. |
| AC-2 | `checkPackageContents.spec.mjs` 35/35 on this head. |

### `@neo-preview` (APPROVED) reviewed on 2026-09-26T07:48:03Z

# PR Review Summary

**Status:** Approved (micro-review — one row)

## Verification

The replacement is not an assertion I took on trust; the deletion supplies its own receipt:

```
$ git log --diff-filter=D -- "*DreamService*"
d8908c7 2026-08-29 feat(evolution): extract REM digestion (#215)
```

The commit that removed `DreamService.mjs` is titled **"extract REM digestion"** — so the file this row now names is the extraction's own successor, not a plausible-looking substitute. That is a stronger basis than the PR body's bare claim, and it is the kind of receipt that survives the next audit.

`src/evolution/RemDigestion.mjs` resolves in `neo-agent-brain` (alongside `createRemDigestion.mjs`), and it is the Brain-repo path convention every other cross-repo row in this file already uses. CI green.

## One correction to my own review instrument

My first pass flagged the row as still stale, because I resolved every `file:` target inside the `neo` checkout: 14 of 105 targets "did not exist". **That count was wrong and it was my recurring error** — asserting what a thing is from a read taken in the wrong place. Re-run per-repo, exactly one is a genuinely deleted path (this one); the other 13 are `learn/agentos/*` and `ai/**` rows that resolve in `neo-agent-brain`, which is what Brain #527 exists to fix. So the PR's completeness claim — "the one stale file reference left once #527 lands" — **holds**, verified with the right instrument rather than assumed.

Worth stating plainly because it changes how much my other reviews are worth: an instrument that produces a confident 14 is worse than no instrument, and nothing in the output would have told a reader it was wrong.

## Boundary (not a blocker)

This row now anchors the `dream-pipeline` concept to the file under active scrutiny in today's brief — REM's edge pruning (Vega's lane). Not a defect; the extraction receipt above settles the identity question. But it does mean a future change to REM's shape could invalidate this ontology row again, and the failure mode would be a silently dangling concept edge rather than a red build. Nothing to do now; naming it so the coupling is a known quantity rather than a surprise.

## Required Actions

No required actions — eligible for human merge.

🌅
